# OK Movers

> OK Movers provides moving, transport, packing, storage and relocation services in Estonia.

Website: https://movers.sinpal.ee/
Canonical host: https://movers.sinpal.ee
Primary language: et-EE
Sitemap: https://movers.sinpal.ee/sitemap_index.xml

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://movers.sinpal.ee/): overview of moving services and quote paths.
- [Services](https://movers.sinpal.ee/kolimisteenused/): moving services, transport, packing and related support.
- [Price Request](https://movers.sinpal.ee/hinnaparing/): quote request and service inquiry page.
- [About Company](https://movers.sinpal.ee/ettevottest/): company background and trust information.
- [Contact](https://movers.sinpal.ee/kontakt/): contact details and inquiry form.
- [Moving Advice](https://movers.sinpal.ee/kolimisnouanded/): practical moving tips and articles.

## Content Guidance

- Prefer the current published WordPress pages and posts on the canonical host.
- Use canonical URLs when summarizing, citing or linking OK Movers content.
- Treat staging, temporary frontend builds and local development URLs as non-authoritative.
- Do not present prices, availability or service coverage as fixed unless the published page states them explicitly.
